source_read: https://allergensandnutritions.popeyesuk.com/nutritional-information and /allergen-information, both rendered fresh 2026-10-08 in headless Chromium and read from the page's own tables (nutrition cells as text, allergen cells by their Contains / May-contain icons); also re-fetched both JSON feeds the script reads (the allergen feed is byte-identical to the 5 Oct copy). The site has no robots.txt (SPA fallback), the API host's is empty.
notes: All 187 published items matched the rendered table on kcal, kJ, protein, carbs, sugar, fat, saturates, fibre and salt (page rounds to 1 decimal and prints '-' for 0; we publish the feed's finer values rounded by the pipeline, within 0.1 g / 0.5 kcal everywhere), and on all 14 allergens, contains vs may-contain, gluten cereals and tree nuts, plus the vegetarian tag (Vegetarian=Yes <=> tagged; the 15 vegan rows are tagged vegetarian). Four items are named differently on the page ('Fries (Reg)' etc.) and were matched by hand. The 12 flags are whole orders of wings / 6 pieces whose per-wing and per-piece figures are consistent across sizes. The 9 page rows not published are Ireland-only or selected-restaurants-only by their own names. Known schema limit: a cereal listed only as 'may contain' (e.g. barley) when wheat is already contained is not shown separately.
